result.question: I have Jameson Williams on my bench and George Pickens in my starting lineup, who should I pick?
result.answer: Start George Pickens over Jameson Williams. George Pickens gets the start over Jameson Williams in week 7. Pickens owns a 21.9% target share and 8.7 targets per game, producing 10.9 half-PPR points, and faces a PHI defense that allows 31.8 half-PPR points per game to WRs (rank 3), far more favorable than Williams' matchup against GB (26 allowed, rank 17). Though Williams is more touchdown-reliant at 24.7% of his half-PPR points coming from scores (vs Pickens' 9.2%), Pickens' higher usage and significantly softer defensive spot make him the stronger weekly play in half-PPR.

claims.text: George Pickens: DAL, WR, roster status ACT (week 7). Jameson Williams: DET, WR, roster status ACT (week 7).

evidence.sql: SELECT r.gsis_id, r.full_name, r.team, r.position, r.status, r.week FROM NFLVERSE.rosters r JOIN (SELECT gsis_id, MAX(week) AS week FROM NFLVERSE.rosters WHERE season = 2026 AND LOWER(full_name) IN ('jameson williams', 'george pickens', 'i have', 'have jameson', 'williams on', 'on my', 'my bench', 'bench and', 'and george', 'pickens in', 'in my', 'my starting', 'starting lineup', 'lineup who', 'who should', 'should i', 'i pick', 'i have jameson', 'have jameson williams', 'jameson williams on', 'williams on my', 'on my bench', 'my bench and', 'bench and george', 'and george pickens', 'george pickens in', 'pickens in my', 'in my starting', 'my starting lineup', 'starting lineup who', 'lineup who should', 'who should i', 'should i pick') GROUP BY gsis_id) latest ON r.gsis_id = latest.gsis_id AND r.week = latest.week WHERE r.season = 2026 AND r.position IN ('QB', 'RB', 'WR', 'TE') ORDER BY r.full_name

claims.text: Pickens has a 21.9% target share and 8.7 targets per game for 10.9 half-PPR points, while Williams has a 15.2% target share and 5.8 targets per game for 9.7 half-PPR points.

evidence.sql: SELECT ps.player_display_name AS player, ps.week, ps.opponent_team, ROUND(100 * sc.offense_pct, 1) AS snap_pct, ps.targets, ROUND(100 * ps.target_share, 1) AS target_share_pct, ps.receptions, ps.carries, ROUND((ps.fantasy_points + ps.fantasy_points_ppr) / 2, 1) AS half_ppr_points FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats ps LEFT JOIN NFLVERSE.snap_counts sc ON sc.game_id = ps.game_id AND sc.player = ps.player_display_name AND sc.team = ps.team WHERE ps.season = 2026 AND ps.player_id IN ('00-0037240', '00-0037247') ORDER BY ps.player_display_name, ps.week

claims.text: Jameson Williams accounts for 24.7% of his half-PPR points from touchdowns (12 of 48.6) versus George Pickens' 9.2% (6 of 65.3).

evidence.sql: SELECT ps.player_display_name AS player, SUM(ps.receiving_tds + ps.rushing_tds) AS touchdowns, 6 * SUM(ps.receiving_tds + ps.rushing_tds) AS td_points, ROUND(SUM((ps.fantasy_points + ps.fantasy_points_ppr) / 2), 1) AS half_ppr_points, ROUND(100 * 6 * SUM(ps.receiving_tds + ps.rushing_tds) / NULLIF(SUM((ps.fantasy_points + ps.fantasy_points_ppr) / 2), 0), 1) AS td_share_pct FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats ps WHERE ps.season = 2026 AND ps.player_id IN ('00-0037240', '00-0037247') GROUP BY ps.player_display_name ORDER BY ps.player_display_name

claims.text: Pickens faces PHI allowing 31.8 half-PPR points per game to WRs (rank 3), while Williams faces GB allowing 26 half-PPR points per game to WRs (rank 17).
